title: Sunken City of Poseidos
content: Here's a glimpse of the sunken city of Poseidos, combined with an excerpt of the ZBS audio adventure of "Dinotopia: The World Beneath"—(turn audio on). (Link to video)Jeffrey asks onInstagram: "Have any good tips for underwater effects and lighting?"A: The main thing I kept in mind here was super-soft gradations of tone and a bluish cast to the colors.----CD:Digital download:
